name: Sumith Abeykoon
headline: Experimental geoscientist · Petrology and volcanology

contact.affiliation: CNR-ISSMC, Faenza · CNR research unit (Unità di Ricerca presso Terzi) and GLASS lab, Roma Tre University, Rome

summary: Experimental geoscientist specialising in petrology and volcanology. I recreate the conditions of planetary interiors in the laboratory and combine high-pressure, high-temperature experiments with a broad suite of analytical techniques to study how deep planetary processes regulate magmatic systems, volcanic activity and planetary evolution.
competencies: Synthesis of silicate glasses and melts for experiments
High-P–T experimental techniques: operation, installation, calibration and management
Chemical and structural characterisation of silicate materials, experimental and natural
Thermal analysis of silicate glasses and melts
Characterisation of volcanic products by 3D microtomography (porosity and texture)
Planning, designing and executing in situ experiments at synchrotron and neutron facilities

education_notes.2018 – 2022: German–Japanese IRTG “Deep Earth Volatile Cycles”. Thesis: Experimental constraints on the compositions of sulphides and aqueous fluids in the Earth’s interior. Committee: D. J. Frost, C. McCammon, A. Audétat.
education_notes.2016 – 2018: Thesis: Oxygen content of mantle sulphides. Supervisors: V. Laurenz, D. J. Frost.
education_notes.2008 – 2013: Thesis: Effect of forest management on soil carbon sequestration, Maragamuwa biodiversity conservation site, Naula.

skills.Experimental: Multi-anvil apparatus; piston cylinder; Paris–Edinburgh cell; cold-seal and TZM rapid-quench pressure vessels; gas-mixing furnace
skills.Analytical: EPMA; SEM; LA-ICP-MS; Raman spectroscopy; conventional and flash DSC, TGA, TMA; in situ high-P–T neutron diffraction; powder XRD; Mössbauer spectroscopy; synchrotron and laboratory micro-CT

technical: Testing and commissioning of an automated end-loaded piston cylinder (MAVO PRESS LPC 250–300/50, Voggenreiter) at CRPG, Nancy

Design and testing of a modified 18 mm multi-anvil assembly with a LaCrO₃ resistive heater, Bayerisches Geoinstitut
Design and testing of a modified Paris–Edinburgh cell for high-P–T experiments at SOLEIL (PSICHE) and ESRF (ID27)
